title: Truth gives the heart a steadier worth
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 119
summary: The shabad begins with those who please the Lord being linked to Truth. It grows into praise, sacrifice to such people, and the state of being absorbed into the Truest of the True.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person borrowing dignity from response, success, or praise. Read this shabad when approval starts naming your value, and it will return worth to Truth instead of the room's reaction.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: let Truth, not applause, give the heart its place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae ||
lines.translation: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sach seveh sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach saalaahaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhiaain se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeh dhekhaa sach sabhanee thaiee ||
lines.translation: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa ||2||
lines.translation: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa maar sach samaanee ||
lines.translation: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ein man ddeeThee sabh aavan jaanee ||
lines.translation: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve sadhaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabadh ridhai dhikhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gur sabadhee sach paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam samaaleh se vaddabhaagee ||
lines.translation: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh aap milaae satasa(n)gat sach gun gaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhaa paReeaai je lekhe vich hovai ||
lines.translation: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh agam agochar sabadh sudh hovai ||
lines.translation: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin sach sabadh saalaahee hor koi na keemat paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee ||
lines.translation: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tirasanaa jaale sudh na kaiee ||
lines.translation: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bikh bihaajheh bikh moh piaase kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadhee eko jaanaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoojaa maar man sach samaanaa ||
lines.translation: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak eko naam varatai man a(n)tar gur parasaadhee paavaniaa ||8||17||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

structure: First, it starts with the ones pleasing the Lord already linked to Truth.
Then, it shows praise and service growing naturally from that alignment.
Finally, it ends where the heart is absorbed into the Truest of the True instead of applause.
